W.note: Egg-shaped yellow blob with harsh glittery speckle noise and no visible nub or stem; mobile layout has the panel covering the model.

X.note: Pitted, nicely lit peel but the body is a tall rounded capsule (more like a corn cob or pill) with only a faint tip, and a leaf that looks detached at the bottom.

Y.note: Smooth, convincing lemon-yellow ovoid with soft shading, floor shadow and cut-open options, but the nub shows only from some angles and is mostly a round egg at rest.

Z.note: Unmistakably a lemon with a clear pointed nub, stem and leaf, fine pitted peel, soft highlights and tidy controls, though the leaf clips at the viewport edge.
